ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: clean hands
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Bring every kitchen up to at least neutral cleanliness and move butcher tables out of them, so meals stop giving people food poisoning.

plain.li: I cook in the same room where someone butchered a muffalo yesterday, and then we wonder why people are throwing up.
I want a clean kitchen with no guts on the floor, and the butchering done in a room of its own.

warm.li: I want to feed you all without making anyone sick. Help me keep the kitchen clean.

blunt.li: The kitchen is a crime scene. Fix it, or start cooking for yourselves.

cheerful.li: Think how nice it'd be to cook on a floor that isn't sticky!

gloomy.li: Someone's going to die of a bad stew one day. I'd rather it wasn't my stew.

cold.li: Food poisoning costs us days of labor every season. Removing the cause is cheap.

plain.li: The floors are scrubbed and the butchering's moved out. Dinner's ready.

cheerful.li: Look at that floor! You could eat off it, though I'd rather you used the tables.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: law and order
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a prison cell with a bed, so captured raiders can be held, healed and maybe recruited.

plain.li: The last raider we captured had to sleep tied up in the storeroom. We need a proper cell.
A cell needs a bed and a door that locks. We have the materials for both.

warm.li: Not everyone who attacks us is a monster. Give them a bed and a chance.

blunt.li: We need somewhere to put the ones who survive. Preferably somewhere with a lock.

cheerful.li: Every raider we capture is a friend who doesn't know it yet! All we need is a cell and some patience.

gloomy.li: There are too few of us, and the only strangers who come here are the ones shooting at us. We might as well keep some.

cold.li: Captured raiders are labor, information, or ransom. A cell lets us decide which.

plain.li: One cell with a bed and a lock. All it needs now is someone in it.

cold.li: The cell is ready. The next raid should be more productive.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the brewmasters
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build three fermenting barrels and store twenty-five drinks (beer, or whatever your barrels make) for parties and for bad days.

plain.li: Give me a few barrels, some hops and a season, and I'll give this colony a reason to sit down together.
A drink at the end of a hard week would do us all good. Let's brew some.

warm.li: When we make it through another winter, I'd like us to have something to toast with.

blunt.li: I'm not getting through another raid sober. Build the barrels.

cheerful.li: Our own beer, with our own name on the barrel! I've already got ideas for the name.

gloomy.li: If we're all going to die out here, we might as well have a drink first.

cold.li: Beer improves morale at low cost, and every trader who comes through will buy it.

plain.li: The first barrel's tapped. Cheers, all of you, we earned this.

cheerful.li: To us, to beer, and to not dying!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: stone and mortar
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Rebuild the colony's walls until at least four in five are stone or metal, so a single fire can't take the whole place.

plain.li: One spark in the wrong place and most of this colony burns. I want stone walls.
We built in wood because we were desperate. We're not desperate now. Let's build to last.

warm.li: I want our homes to still be standing in ten years. Stone, please.

blunt.li: Wood burns. Replace it with stone.

cheerful.li: Big, solid stone walls that look good and don't burn!

gloomy.li: I keep dreaming about fire. Stone walls would let me sleep.

cold.li: Flammable walls are a structural liability. Replace them.

plain.li: Let them bring their torches.

cold.li: Fire risk reduced to acceptable levels.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: no dark corners
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put a light in every room where people work, eat or sleep. People work slower and feel worse in the dark.

plain.li: Most of our rooms are pitch black after sundown, and the work slows to a crawl. We need lights.
I walked into a wall in my own home last night. We need a light in every room.

warm.li: I'd like a lamp burning in every room in the evenings. It makes a place feel lived in.

blunt.li: I can't see what I'm doing and neither can you. Lamps.

cheerful.li: Let's have a light glowing in every window!

gloomy.li: The dark gets into your head after a while. I'd like it out of mine.

cold.li: Darkness costs us work speed, and lighting is cheap.

plain.li: Every room lit. Funny how much bigger the place looks.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a master healer
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Train a colonist up to Medicine 10 and keep ten medicine in stock, so you have a skilled doctor before the next disaster rather than after it.

plain.li: Somebody here has to get really good at stitching people back together. I volunteer, but I'll need practice.
Our doctor can set a bone and not much else. I want someone trained properly.

warm.li: Let me learn. I'd rather patch you up than bury you.

blunt.li: Our best doctor couldn't remove a splinter. That has to change.

cheerful.li: Who wants to be my first practice patient? I'll be very gentle!

gloomy.li: Sooner or later someone will be bleeding out on the table. I want steady hands there when it happens.

cold.li: Training a doctor costs time and nothing else. It's the cheapest protection we have.

plain.li: We've got a real doctor now. Try not to make work for them.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a master's hand
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Train a colonist up to Crafting 12, so the colony can make good gear, good armor and goods worth trading.

plain.li: One of us should get good enough at the bench to make things that last.
Give me the bench and the materials, and in a season I'll make armor you'd trust your life to.

warm.li: I want to make things that keep you all safe. Let me practice.

blunt.li: Our gear is garbage. I can fix that if you let me.

cheerful.li: I've got so many ideas for things to make, if I can only get good enough!

gloomy.li: The raiders have better gear every time. One day that'll be the difference.

cold.li: Item quality scales with skill. Investing in one crafter pays back across the whole colony.

plain.li: Look at the stitching on that. That's craftsmanship.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the long store
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put away 150 pemmican. It keeps for months without a freezer, so it's there for caravans, sieges and a winter that runs long.

plain.li: Pemmican tastes like an old boot, but it lasts for months. I want a hundred and fifty packs of it.
If the meat spoils or the winter runs long, I want food that keeps.

warm.li: I'd sleep easier knowing there's food put away for the hard times.

blunt.li: Fresh food rots and pemmican doesn't. Get cooking.

cheerful.li: A hundred and fifty snacks that never go bad!

gloomy.li: The lean times always come. Better to be ready.

cold.li: Preserved rations keep us fed whatever the weather does. I recommend it.

plain.li: There's enough pemmican to walk halfway across the world on, or to see us through a bad winter.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: rest for the dead
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Dig three graves, so the colony's dead can be buried properly.

plain.li: We've buried people in ditches. We can do better than that.
I'm asking for somewhere we can put flowers and say goodbye properly.

warm.li: The ones we lose deserve a place. Let's give them one.

blunt.li: Bodies in the yard aren't good for anyone. Graves.

cheerful.li: It's not cheerful, I know. But a quiet garden for the departed could be lovely.

gloomy.li: We'll all need one eventually. Might as well be ready.

cold.li: Unburied corpses depress morale. Graves are efficient.

plain.li: There's proper ground for our dead now, with a fence around it.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a seat of power
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a throne room with a throne and an impressiveness of at least 50, as your noble's title requires.

plain.li: If we're going to keep nobles, they need a throne room to hold court in.
The Empire judges us by how we receive its people, and right now we'd be judged badly.

warm.li: A grand hall would make our noble proud, and the rest of us too.

blunt.li: Our noble keeps complaining. Build the throne room and maybe the complaining stops.

cheerful.li: A throne with banners behind it! Can I try sitting in it once?

gloomy.li: Our noble's mood gets worse every week without a throne room. I'd rather not find out where that ends.

cold.li: Unmet title requirements cost us goodwill and mood. A throne room resolves it.

plain.li: A seat fit for a noble. Mind the steps.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: school days
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Set up three school desks so the colony's children can learn properly.

plain.li: The children need a proper place to learn, with desks and someone to teach them.
The kids are the colony in twenty years. Let's teach them something.

warm.li: I want them to grow up knowing more than we did.

blunt.li: The children are running feral. Give them desks and lessons.

cheerful.li: A classroom! I'll teach them everything, even the boring parts.

gloomy.li: If we don't teach them, they'll learn the hard way, like we did.

cold.li: Educated children become productive adults faster.

plain.li: Desks in a row, chalk on the board. Sit down, everyone, class is in.
